caption: AI drafts look polished but can miss context. This carousel gives a practical QA flow to verify AI outputs. Which prompt will you try first? #AIQA #Productivity #AIinBusiness

slides.title: Your AI checks miss context
slides.body: Polished AI drafts hide gaps. Here are five prompts to verify accuracy, bias, recency, and relevance.

slides.title: 1. Diagnose gaps
slides.body: Task: AI draft; list missing sources and biases. Placeholder: [PASTE HERE]. Output: a structured list of gaps.

slides.title: 2. Improve grounding
slides.body: Task: Add citations, date checks, and decision criteria to draft. Placeholder: [OUTPUT WITHOUT CITED SOURCES]. Output: reformatted with sources bracketed.

slides.title: 3. Apply to decision
slides.body: Task: Apply to a live decision; summarize impact, risks, and next steps. Placeholder: [DECISION]. Output: concise verdict and plan.

slides.title: 4. Check alignment
slides.body: Task: Verify draft aligns with stated business goals and metrics. Placeholder: [GOALS]. Output: alignment score 0-100 with brief justification.

slides.title: 5. Refine workflow
slides.body: Task: Turn this into a repeatable QA process; produce a checklist and schedule. Placeholder: [CHECKLIST]. Output: reusable checklist.

slides.title: Takeaway
slides.body: Use this five-prompt QA as a repeatable habit to verify AI output before acting.
